title: devbin from Homebrew on macOS and Linux, with no source checkout: the formula, the tap, and projects vendoring from the brew install
objective: devbin installs with `brew install` on macOS and on Linux, from a tap, with nothing installed from a local checkout, and every project vendors from that install and finds it again after `brew upgrade`. Done when devbin installed from the tap works on this Mac and on kovacs (Ubuntu 26.04.1, aarch64): `brew install`, `brew test`, `devbin install --into` a fixture project, a bare `bin/devbin upgrade` and `doctor` reading the brew install, and the same after `brew upgrade` to a later tag.
context:
Started by hv on 2026-10-16, ruling question 10 of ST0008's design v0.8 (a): "start it". hv's ask of 2026-10-14: "I want BOTH devbin and intent work from 'brew install' and for them to BOTH work seamlessly on Unix (the kovacs VM in this case)", and "devbin doesn't have a brew piepline at all, so we need to make one now". Intent's ST0081 is the same work for Intent.

Already built, as issues: 0195 (landed at 93259543), the formula kept as a template at packaging/homebrew/devbin.rb, `bin/devbin formula render|publish`, a project finding the brew install at HOMEBREW_PREFIX's opt/devbin with no machine pointer, and devbin's own install and upgrade refusing to write into the keg; 0197 (approved 2026-10-16), what install.prefix and fleet mean on a machine whose install is Homebrew's, with `--point` as the explicit override.

Done on 2026-10-17, at devbin 0.1.11 (0fc22669): the tap matthewsinclair/homebrew-devbin was created at hv's ask, private, since devbin's repository is private and the formula's url is ssh; hv ran `bin/devbin formula publish` at hv's terminal, and the tap's main is 3f2fecf, Formula/devbin.rb at tag v0.1.11, revision 0fc22669. Installed from the tap and proven on this Mac (rhad) and on kovacs (Ubuntu 26.04.1, aarch64, Homebrew 7.0.9, kovacs order K012, rc 0): brew tap over ssh, brew install, brew test, `devbin --version` reading 0.1.11 at 0fc22669, and a fixture project vendored with `devbin install --into` whose bare `bin/devbin upgrade` was already up to date and whose doctor (13 checks, 0 failed) read the install through HOMEBREW_PREFIX's opt/devbin with no machine pointer. devbin stays installed by brew on both machines.

Closed on 2026-10-17 on hv's word: dc drafted the work packages and vc minted them; cc built the rest, landed at 1c34549c on landing suite 20261017-1323 (2386 ok, 0 not ok): devbin's release declares `after: bin/devbin formula publish`, so each cut publishes the formula past its push and a failed publish is step 10's FAILED row with the release standing (AC-1.2); the 0195 arm holds that a project vendored from Homebrew's install records the kind alone and resolves it to opt, never the keg (AC-4.1); and `brew audit --strict` on the tap's formula found nothing (AC-2.2). `brew upgrade` to a later tag (AC-5.1) was withdrawn to issue 0201, read at the next batch release (directive 13). brew on hv's login PATH on kovacs is hv's choice and outside this thread. ST0008 (WSL) depended on this thread: its WSL job's fixtures can vendor from the Linux brew install.

wps.title: The formula published to the tap, and each cut publishing it
wps.objective: bin/devbin formula publish renders packaging/homebrew/devbin.rb at the newest release tag and commits it to the tap matthewsinclair/homebrew-devbin as Formula/devbin.rb; it runs at hv's terminal, since a push from an agent session is refused. Once the tap holds a formula, devbin's release config declares an after: step running formula publish, so each later cut publishes it, and docs/releasing.md stops saying there is no tap.

wps.title: Installed from the tap on this Mac (rhad)
wps.objective: On rhad, with nothing installed from a checkout for the proof, brew tap matthewsinclair/devbin and brew install devbin fetch over the formula's ssh url (the network half 0195 did not rehearse); brew test devbin passes and the devbin on PATH is the keg's; brew audit --strict is read and each finding fixed or accepted with its reason.

wps.title: Installed from the tap on kovacs (Ubuntu 26.04.1, aarch64)
wps.objective: The same as WP-02 on kovacs, Ubuntu 26.04.1 aarch64 under Homebrew on Linux, with uutils as coreutils and mawk as awk; the formula's on_macos bash dependency does not apply, so Ubuntu's bash meets the bash >= 5 floor. Run as a kovacs order with brew taken from its full path; brew on hv's login PATH there is hv's choice and not this package's.

wps.title: Projects vendor from the brew install, and find it again
wps.objective: On each machine a fixture project vendored with devbin install --into from the brew install finds it again: a bare bin/devbin upgrade and bin/devbin doctor read it through HOMEBREW_PREFIX's opt/devbin/libexec with no machine pointer and no DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX, and an arm holds this on a fixture prefix laid out as Homebrew lays one out, so it runs without brew.
